methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + similar-valuation-tier peers in AI & Software. Range: $29.0B - $312.5B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in AI & Compute

data.narrative:
Waymo, a private-stage AI & Software company, is valued at $126B and has raised $16B+ to date. The peer universe for this analysis comprises one public comparable (Palantir at $312.5B) and eight private peers including Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition, with valuations ranging across the AI & Software sector.

The peer-median method was applied using three same-sector, similar-valuation-tier comparables: Palantir ($312.5B, public), Figure AI ($39.0B, Series C), and Scale AI ($29.0B, Series B). This peer cohort yields a median valuation of $39.0B, with a range of $29.0B to $312.5B. Given Waymo's later-stage maturity and capital raised relative to Figure AI and Scale AI, the peer median provides a reasonable anchor point.

Triangulation across available methodologies supports a valuation range of $33.1B (low) to $44.9B (high), with a median of $39.0B. This range sits materially below Waymo's stated $126B valuation. The primary constraint is data sparsity—only one method could be applied—limiting confidence in the synthesis. Key uncertainties include the appropriate discount or premium for Waymo's autonomous vehicle domain focus versus broader AI comparables, and the relevance of Palantir's public-market valuation as an anchor for private peer assessment.
